cards.front: Polycystic ovary syndrome in adults is diagnosed using the [___] criteria.
cards.context:
In adults, exclude other causes before applying two of three features: ovulatory dysfunction, clinical or biochemical hyperandrogenism, and polycystic ovarian morphology.

Morphology can be defined by ultrasound or AMH within the adult diagnostic algorithm. AMH alone does not diagnose the syndrome; it is not recommended for diagnosis in adolescents.

With irregular cycles and hyperandrogenism, ultrasound or AMH is unnecessary for diagnosis once alternative causes are excluded.

cards.front: In syphilis serology, a treponemal test confirms infection and stays positive for life, so treatment response is followed with the non-treponemal [___] titre.
cards.context:
Treponemal tests (EIA or CMIA, TPPA) confirm infection and usually stay positive for life, so they cannot show cure or reinfection.

The non-treponemal titre reflects disease activity. A fourfold fall after treatment shows an adequate response.
